p: heaven and earth: He accuses man's ingratitude, which cannot depend on God's power.
slumber: He shows that God's providence not only watches over his Church in general, but also over every member of it.
smite thee by day: Neither heat nor cold, nor any inconvenience will be able to destroy God's Church, even though for a time they may molest it.
going out and thy coming in: Whatever you attempt will have good success.
